description: This file contains unit tests for the EventBusTenantManagementAdapter class in the org.eclipse.hono.service.management.tenant package. It tests validation logic for tenant payloads, including validation of certificates, payload content, and specific request scenarios.

classes.name: EventBusTenantManagementAdapterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for EventBusTenantManagementAdapter, testing validation logic for tenant management payloads.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the static adapter instance with overridden getService method using Mockito.

methods.name: verifyValidPayload
methods.description: Tests that a valid tenant payload is accepted.

methods.name: verifyValidationFailsForInvalidMinMessageSize
methods.description: Tests validation failure when the minimum message size is negative.

methods.name: verifyValidationFailsForUnsupportedSamplingMode
methods.description: Tests validation failure for an unsupported tracing sampling mode.

methods.name: verifyValidTrustedCaSpec
methods.description: Tests that a payload with a trusted CA certificate is considered valid.

methods.name: verifyInvalidTrustedCaSpec
methods.description: Tests that a payload with a subject DN but no trusted CA public key is invalid.

methods.name: buildTenantPayload
methods.description: Creates a sample tenant payload JsonObject with tracing configuration and adapter settings.

methods.name: getCaCertificate
methods.description: Generates a self-signed X509Certificate used in trust validation tests.
